representative_rule: Sort by full-data imbalance ratio then name; select minimum, lower median, maximum. No prediction or model metric is used.
roc: For each representative dataset, use all main models, seed zero, persisted minority-positive scores.
confusion: Sum all five holdout confusion matrices on each representative dataset; paper versus the baseline with greatest equal-weight holdout balanced accuracy on all twelve datasets. Descriptive comparison, not deployment selection.

learning.rule: Nested stratified prefixes inside each inner training fold; no original outer test rows. Parameters are those already selected by balanced-accuracy inner CV on the original outer training set.

validation.rule: Vary one parameter; all others fixed at the original training-selected values. Descriptive curves, no new selection.

notebook.dataset_rule: Fewest rows, then name; no performance criterion.
notebook.rule: Execute all five outer splits of each protocol and inner tuning in a fresh temporary output inside the notebook; never reuse fitted caches. Full comparison comes from saved results.

limitation: Curve parameters reuse original inner selection: validation curves are descriptive and not an unbiased generalization estimate. Outer tests remain excluded.
